choices.choice: Operation create_image_pro_flash at native 16x16 (width/height 16) with no_background true
choices.reason: Only discovered generation tool; 16 is within its 16-256 multipleOf-4 range so no resize from an oversized canvas is needed; no_background expresses the transparent-background requirement. The fixture's 64x64 default is overridden explicitly.

choices.choice: Bare checkmark motif, no circle/badge, no text
choices.reason: Expert choice: strongest single-shape success symbol at 16x16; avoids circular forms that could later collide with a Retry arrow and keeps a grayscale-distinct silhouette for the Paused/Retry non-color requirement. Scoped to this sample.

choices.choice: Color wording 'cool light-blue accent (around #70b9ed)' with lighter/deeper blue shading
choices.reason: Carries the owner's cool-blue direction and the observed Start fill as a cue; shading is a prompt suggestion, not a palette rule.

choices.choice: Negative prompt cues (no spinner, arrows, cross, pause bars, text, badge)
choices.reason: Supports the owner's success-vs-activity/retry/paused distinction; they are prompt cues, and success_meaning is the binding criterion.
